snippet.title: Batnum (1967) | The Early History of Video Games | Part 19
snippet.description:
John Kemeny's Batnum is a previously lost early BASIC game. It's a simulation of a Nim variant, with the term "Batnum" being a contraction of "Battle of Numbers." There is only one pile of objects, and a set limit on how many objects can be removed per turn. 

The first round of this particular game is always the same, and the only instance of the computer playing imperfectly. Later rounds are fully randomised, and the computer has perfect play, making winning after the first round close to impossible.

This game was recovered courtesy of MyAbandonware user Benedict: https://www.myabandonware.com/game/batnum-sgo

Want to learn more? Read about it here: https://obsessivegamingchronology.blogspot.com/2024/12/not-so-impossible-after-all-batnum-1967.html
